intro: I am interested in the Observability Platform Engineer opportunity supporting NorthMark Compute Cloud / NM2.com. The role aligns strongly with my background in enterprise observability, telemetry analysis, APM platforms, dashboards, alerting, production troubleshooting, Python automation, and cloud-oriented reliability operations.
body: At Citi, I supported observability, capacity, and production reliability workflows across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, AWS-backed reporting layers, and infrastructure telemetry feeds from more than 6,000 endpoints. I built Python, SQL, Pandas, and PySpark workflows that transformed telemetry into validated dashboards, reports, forecasting datasets, and operational insights.

Earlier, at G6 Hospitality and CA Technologies/TIAA-CREF, I worked directly with Dynatrace AppMon, Gomez Synthetic Monitoring, CA APM/Introscope, JMX monitoring, dashboards, alerts, transaction visibility, and performance-analysis workflows. I partnered with engineering and operations teams to identify bottlenecks, improve telemetry visibility, and document repeatable troubleshooting practices.

For NM2, my immediate value is enterprise observability depth, telemetry interpretation, Python and shell automation, platform reliability thinking, and strong production troubleshooting discipline. I also bring active ramp-up in OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, and IaC-adjacent cloud-native observability practices aligned to modern PaaS environments.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my observability, APM, telemetry, automation, and reliability background can support NM2's cloud-first platform objectives.
